messages.subject: Using sd as colour aesthetic
parts:
I, for some reason, can not get this to work - I hope I can explain it
properly.

I have a huge dataframe containing chromatographic data from several
samples with the coloumns:

'Sample' 'Time' 'Intensity'

As part of a summerization of data I wish to plot the chromatogram of
one "well-behaved" sample and assign a colour aesthetic to the line
relative to the standard deviation of intensities at that time point.
Thus

p <- ggplot(df, aes(Time, Intensity))
p <- p + geom_line(data=subset(df, Sample=='a'), colour =
stat_summary(data =df, fun.y = sd))

(I know the colour call is not meaningfull but I think this is the
best way to explain my intentions)

I hope anyone will have a solution for this

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Using sd as colour aesthetic
parts:
Stat summary does not currently produce colour aesthetics (only x, and
y). You'll need to compute the summary yourself.

Hadley
